viewModels.scope: Shell window/navigation actions and the shared Claude-inspired component/theme system (cards, selects, forms, drawers, modals, loading and motion) are UI-only. The single Discord-style rail for built-in pages and websites, local web-workspace.json bookmarks/order/motion preferences, unprivileged browser tab navigation and tab management are desktop presentation, not market operations; intentionally no CLI/MCP arbitrary-URL browser execution, session/cookie access or window controls. The macOS shell MenuBarQuoteController presents quotes and watchlist choices through the existing QuoteHub; status-item rendering, current-symbol selection, hide/show and native lifecycle have no MCP window-control tools. Background window visibility, chrome timers and native restore controls are desktop presentation; closeAction remains update_preferences.

CopyMcpSetupAsync.uiOnly: Copies harness-neutral read-only MCP and skill setup instructions to the clipboard; local diagnostic status is not market health or authorization.
